M-DOTNET.Purpose: The dotnet domain (the dotnet section of Scripts/_lib.py): the development build (all projects in Debug) and the offline xunit harness. MSBuild remains the single build mechanism; this section only invokes it as a command.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Scripts/_lib.py (dotnet section): ProjectSet/PROJECTS (the built surface), make_product, xunit_run, source_fingerprint.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Build configuration and deployment — owned by M-MSBUILD; invoked here as a command.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Release compilation — owned by the future delivery command (PRIN-004); the gate is Debug-only.

Requirements.REQ-001: A Debug build of the test mod carries [Conditional("DEBUG")] markers into the game container (M-MSBUILD.REQ-001).
Requirements.REQ-002: A nonzero dotnet exit fails the task loudly as harness-did-not-run, never as a data verdict.
Requirements.REQ-003: The gate builds Debug only: iterations never pay Release costs; a Release compile check is a delivery concern, not a verification one.

M-DOTNET.Codemap: * `PROJECTS` : `ProjectSet` ; the only csproj coordinate source (dotnet domain) * `make_product` -> `dotnet build -c Debug` x (PROJECTS.product + PROJECTS.test_mods) ; fingerprint-resumable * `xunit_run(dotnet_filter, check)` -> `dotnet test --filter` : the test command harness (check=False => rc as verdict; `all` composes it after build) * `source_fingerprint` -> `tree_digest(Source/ + props)` => resume decision * `_dotnet` : nonzero exit => StageFailure(DID_NOT_RUN) ; `-p:NuGetAudit=false` (vuln-data worker ignores nuget_env redirects => NU1900; audits belong to delivery) </Codemap> </M-DOTNET>
